title: Listen Nessa, uh Nessa #Broadway #Wicked #wickedthemusical #jennabain...
transcript: This is major. If you haven't heard, Jenna Bainbridge was just announced to be the next Nessa Rose on Broadway. And this will Mark the first time in the show's 20+ year history that an actual wheelchair user has played this role. Obviously, we got Marissa Bodie in the movie, who herself is a wheelchair user, but we've never gotten one on stage before. And traditionally, the reason given for this is that there is a scene in the show that requires Nessa to stand up out of her wheelchair. And as time has gone on, I think a lot of people have realized that's kind of not a very good excuse, because there are some people who are ambulatory wheelchair users, which means they are in a wheelchair but do possess the ability to walk in some capacity. So even without changing the script, you could find a disabled actor that could do the role as written. And as our understanding of disability representation has evolved, I think we've all kind of come to the agreement that disabled actors should be telling disabled stories. And so I am so glad that we are finally getting authentic disabled representation in the musical. And I think that Jenna is going to be perfect. I saw her in SUFFS, and she is so talented. And so on top of the disability representation aspect, which obviously is very important, this is just great casting in general, and I cannot wait to see her.
